user.title: SLEMS system
user.description: Select the measurements of your energy system. Batteries are added afterwards on the integration page.

data_description.grid_power_entity: Power at the grid connection point. Expected sign: positive = import, negative = export.
data_description.grid_power_inverted: Enable if your meter reports export as positive.
data_description.pv_power_entity: Current PV production. Used for the energy flow and the house consumption balance.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Improves the consumption forecast (e.g. heat pump demand).
data_description.pv_forecast_entries: Solar forecast integrations (e.g. Forecast.Solar, Solcast). Several entries, e.g. one per roof plane, are summed up.

data_description.grid_power_entity: Power at the grid connection point. Expected sign: positive = import, negative = export.
data_description.grid_power_inverted: Enable if your meter reports export as positive.
data_description.pv_forecast_entries: Solar forecast integrations (e.g. Forecast.Solar, Solcast). Several entries, e.g. one per roof plane, are summed up.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Improves the consumption forecast (e.g. heat pump demand).

marstek_venus_e3.title: Marstek Venus E 3.0
marstek_venus_e3.description: Connection via Modbus TCP (LAN). The battery accepts only one Modbus connection: do not run another integration on the same battery at the same time.

data_description.skip_connection_test: Save without testing the connection, e.g. while another integration still holds the Modbus connection.

ha_entities.title: Battery from existing entities (read-only)
ha_entities.description: SLEMS only reads this battery and never sends commands. Suitable for simulation mode while another integration controls the battery.

data_description.power_inverted: SLEMS expects positive = charging. Enable if the sensor reports discharging as positive.

user.title: Consumer
user.description: Every consumer needs its own power and energy sensor.

data_description.consumer_type: Heat pump consumption is forecast from the weather; a heating rod is typically used for hot water in summer.
data_description.included_in_meter: Enable if the consumer is behind the smart meter, i.e. its consumption is already part of the measured grid power.

data_description.control_entity: Switch for on/off consumers, number entity in W for power controlled consumers.
data_description.block_entity: While this entity is on, SLEMS does not control the consumer (e.g. blocked by the device or an automation).
data_description.priority: 1 = highest priority when distributing surplus power.

peak_shaving_soc_threshold.name: Peak shaving state of charge threshold
